shortDescription: MONTREAL, Nov. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- PyroGenesis Inc. (“PyroGenesis” or “the Company”) TSX:PYR OTCQX:PYRGF FRA:8PY1, a leader in ultra-high temperature processes and engineering innovation, and a plasma-based technology provider to heavy industry & defense, announces today that it will host…

children: , a leader in ultra-high temperature processes and engineering innovation, and a plasma-based technology provider to heavy industry & defense, announces today that it will host a conference call at 11:00 AM Eastern Time on Friday, November 13, 2026 to discuss the Company’s financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, as well as to provide an update to the Company’s progress and other developments.
To access the conference call by telephone, please pre-register using the following link:
Registrants will receive confirmation with dial-in details.
A live webcast of the conference call can be accessed at the following links:
The webcast will also be available on the Investor Relations section of the Company’s web site in the days following the conference call.

Beginning in 2027, the Company will hold live earnings calls twice annually, in conjunction with the release of its second-quarter (Q2) and year-end financial results, expected around August 15 and March 30, respectively. This change will not affect the Company’s financial reporting obligations, and the Company will continue to publish its quarterly and annual financial results in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

The revised schedule is intended to allow the Company to focus on making its investor communications more substantive, valuable and engaging. By concentrating its live discussions around the Q2 and year-end results, the Company expects to provide more in-depth commentary on its financial performance, business strategy and outlook, while creating greater opportunities for meaningful engagement with investors and analysts. These calls may also include expanded opportunities for questions and discussion. The revised schedule is also consistent with the Company’s ongoing efforts to manage expenses and operate efficiently. Earnings calls are a voluntary practice for publicly traded companies and are not mandated by securities regulations. The Company may reinstitute quarterly calls at any time and may also provide alternative communications during periods when no calls are scheduled, including CEO video updates or presentations.

PyroGenesis leverages 35 years of plasma technology leadership to deliver advanced engineering solutions to energy, propulsion, destruction, process heating, emissions, and materials development challenges across heavy industry and defense. Its customers include global leaders in aluminum, aerospace, steel, iron ore, utilities, environmental services, military, and government. From its Montreal headquarters and local manufacturing facilities, PyroGenesis’ engineers, scientists, and technicians drive innovation and commercialization of energy transition and ultra-high temperature technology. PyroGenesis’ operations are ISO 9001:2015 and AS9100D certified, with ISO certification maintained since 1997. PyroGenesis’ shares trade on the TSX (PYR), OTCQX (PYRGF), and Frankfurt (8PY1) stock exchanges.
